## Predicted Lineup

Attack: Eze, Gyökeres, Madueke [...] On the "hey there, old friend" side of things, former Gunner Olivier Giroud returns to the Emirates for the first time since he left Chelsea five years ago. It will be interesting to see the reception he gets after a rather contentious exit.

## Injuries & Suspensions [...] Arsenal are right back into the thick of a dense run of fixtures, which you would think necessitates rotation from Mikel Arteta. With a three day turnaround, that's the hope.

Eberechi Eze's season has been off to a poor start. He was unused on Saturday as he continues to struggle for match time. Noni Madueke was bright on the left, but with Bukayo Saka looking a shell of his former self, you have to imagine Noni gets the start on the right, which opens up a spot on the left for Eze.

data.title: Arsenal lineup v Lille: Confirmed team news as Gunners make Champions League return - TribalFootball.com
data.content:
Arsenal restart their UEFA Champions League campaign on October 13th as Ligue 1 side Lille land at the Emirates Stadium.

The Gunners secured a 2-1 home win over Leeds United on their return to Premier League action - and this is Mikel Arteta's first home European game of 2026/27 - after winning 1-0 at Napoli in their opener last month.

October is a crunch month for Arteta, with four games across all competitions, and the Spanish coach looks certain to rotate to keep his squad fresh.

## Arsenal v Lille team news

Declan Rice and Ezri Konsa both completed 90 minutes against Leeds, despite being sent home from Thomas Tuchel's England camp due to injury.

Kai Havertz also started - after being released by Germany boss Jurgen Klopp as a precaution - but Viktor Gyokeres could get the nod to start. [...] Jurrien Timber and Bruno Guimaraes could also be drafted in, as the former works back up to full fitness, and latter came off the bench to bag the winner against Leeds.

## Arsenal predicted line up v Lille

Arsenal XI: Raya; Timber, Gabriel, Konsa, Calafiori; Odegaard, Guimaraes, Rice; Saka, Gyokeres, Eze.

## Arsenal v Lille kick off time

Kick off at the Emirates Stadium is set at 8pm in the UK.
